title: 第11章 暗流(2)
content_zh:
陈若秋一愣，看了看高位上明显不悦的老夫人，勉强道：“话虽如此，可小五掉进池塘，也实在太不小心了，身边的几个丫头是怎么照顾人的？大哥大嫂不在身边，便如此奴大欺主了么？依婶婶看，还是将这几个丫头换掉的好。”
任婉云“噗嗤”一声笑出来。陈若秋有些恼怒的看了她一眼，任婉云嘴角挂上一丝了然冷笑。
自己这个弟妹，看上去知书达理的，心却精明的很。这样的话，也就骗骗沈妙那个傻子，大约是想把沈妙身边的人换掉，如今沈玥也到了该留意人家的年龄，京城里，无论沈妙蠢笨怯懦的名声有多远，地位上，沈玥却不如沈妙。毕竟沈信手中还握着兵权。
三房，到底也是蠢蠢欲动了。
沈妙低下头：“三婶为什么要换掉谷雨他们，都是爹和娘留给五娘的人，如今西院的人换了许多，前几日那批二等丫鬟，五娘都一个不认识，再把谷雨几个换掉，西院里，五娘都不知道找谁说话了。”
任婉云的笑容戛然而止。
西院里，沈信夫妇常年不在京城，院里的丫头小厮几乎都被换了个精光，里头有老夫人的人，二房的人，三房的人。不过因为是二房掌家，自然是二房的人多一些。这话不说还好，若是传到外人耳中，大房女儿在自家院子里一个奴仆都不认识，二房和三房能安什么好心？断没有妯娌插手到大哥院子里的道理。
她脑子转的飞快，笑着瞪了一眼陈若秋，对沈妙道：“你三婶是在跟你说笑呢，谷雨几个丫头不过是粗心马虎罢了，咱们沈家心底仁善，做不来这种不近人情的事，小五也莫急。”
话里到了最后还是呛了陈若秋一句。
沈元柏看着自己母亲，又看了看陈若秋，打了个呵欠。沈老夫人正对自己二媳妇和三媳妇之间的唇枪舌战有些不耐烦，见此情景，便道：“成了，不过是些琐碎杂事，老二家的，把七哥儿抱过来，都散了吧。这么多人，吵得头晕脑胀。”

任婉云忙把沈元柏抱到沈老夫人榻上，道：“娘，那媳妇儿们就先下去了。七哥儿，和老夫人玩耍要乖乖的。”
陈若秋看了一眼沈元柏，双手抚上自己的小腹，慢慢走出了荣景堂。二房有个儿子，便得了沈老夫人高看，自己再有本事又如何……沈玥到底是个女儿。要是有个儿子就好了，沈府里，大房的东西迟早要争过来，若有个儿子，至少能平分秋色，不像现在，平白便宜了二房。而且……大房还有个嫡子呢，虽然跟着沈信在边关，可谁知道会不会回来分一杯羹。
想着想着，陈若秋抬起头，目光落在往西院方向去的几人身上。
少女穿着深红色的锦绣长衣，她历来爱穿些艳嫩的色彩，加之没有父母在身边，不会打扮，总会流露出土里土气的感觉。
而现在，深红将她肤色衬托的更加白皙，分明还是那个容貌，却觉得沉肃了不少。甚至有些……威严？
谷雨小声道：“姑娘身子还未大好，何必急急忙忙去广文馆？已经说明了病情，功课也不急于一时。还是……”
“不行。”沈妙打断她的话：“立刻备车。”
分明没有说重话，可不知道为什么，谷雨打了个寒战，竟然什么都不敢多问了。
content_en:
Chen Rouqiu was stunned, looked at the old lady who was clearly unhappy in the high position, and said reluctantly: "Having said that, Xiao Wu fell into the pond too carelessly. How do the girls around him take care of others? Are the eldest brother and sister-in-law so servile and bullying if they are not around? According to Auntie, it is better to replace these girls."
Ren Wanyun burst out laughing. Chen Rouqiu glanced at her angrily, and Ren Wanyun had a knowing sneer on her lips.
My younger brother and sister seem to be well-educated, but they are very shrewd at heart. In this case, the fool Shen Miao was deceived, probably because he wanted to replace the people around Shen Miao. Now Shen Yue has reached the age where she should pay attention to others. In the capital, no matter how far Shen Miao's reputation for being stupid and cowardly is, Shen Yue is not as good as Shen Miao in terms of status. After all, Shen Xin still held military power in his hands.
The third room is finally ready to make a move.
Shen Miao lowered her head: "Why did Third Aunt replace Gu Yu and the others? They are all people left by Father and Mother to Fifth Niang. Nowadays, there have been many changes in the people in the West Courtyard. Among the second-class maids in the past few days, Fifth Niang doesn't know any of them. If Gu Yu is replaced, Fifth Niang will not know who to talk to in the West Courtyard."
Ren Wanyun's smile stopped abruptly.
In the west courtyard, Shen Xin and his wife were away from the capital all year round. Almost all the girls and servants in the courtyard had been replaced. There were people from the old lady, people from the second bedroom, and people from the third bedroom. But because he is the head of the second room, there are naturally more people in the second room. It would be better not to say this, but if it spread to the ears of outsiders, the daughter of the eldest brother does not know a single servant in his own yard, how can the second and third brothers be so kind? There was no reason for my sister-in-law to interfere in my eldest brother's yard.
Her mind was spinning rapidly, she glared at Chen Rouqiu with a smile and said to Shen Miao: "Your third aunt is joking with you. Gu Yu and the other girls are just careless. Our Shen family is kind-hearted and cannot do such inhumane things. Xiao Wu should not be impatient."
At the end of the sentence, Chen Rouqiu still choked.
Shen Yuanbai looked at his mother, then at Chen Rouqiu, and yawned. Mrs. Shen was a little impatient with the quarrel between her second daughter-in-law and her third daughter-in-law. When she saw this scene, she said: "It's done, it's just some trivial matters. From the second daughter-in-law's family, please bring the seventh brother over and let them go. There are so many people, it's so noisy that it makes your head spin."
(adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
Ren Wanyun hurriedly carried Shen Yuanbai to Mrs. Shen's bed and said, "Mom, the wives will go down first. Brother Seven, be good when playing with the old lady."
Chen Rouqiu glanced at Shen Yuanbai, put her hands on her belly, and slowly walked out of Rongjing Hall. The second wife has a son, so she is highly regarded by Mrs. Shen. So what if she is capable... Shen Yue is a daughter after all. It would be great if I had a son. In the Shen Mansion, sooner or later the big house would have to be fought over. If I had a son, I would at least be able to split the difference, unlike now where I get the second house for free. Moreover... Dafang also has a legitimate son. Although he is following Shen Xin at the border, who knows if he will come back to share the pie.
After thinking about it, Chen Rouqiu raised her head and her eyes fell on the few people heading towards the west courtyard.
The girl was wearing a deep red splendid dress. She always liked to wear bright and tender colors, and since she didn't have her parents around and didn't know how to dress up, she always showed a rustic feeling.
But now, the deep red color made her complexion fairer. She still had the same appearance, but she felt a lot more serious. Even a little... majestic?
Guyu whispered: "Girl, you haven't recovered yet, so why rush to the Guangwen Museum? You've already explained your condition, and you won't rush to do your homework. Or..."
"No." Shen Miao interrupted her: "Prepare the car immediately."
He obviously didn't say anything harsh, but for some reason, Gu Yu shuddered and didn't say anything.I dare to ask more questions.
